home.metaTitle: JJD Consult | Maintenance, Renovation and Projects
home.metaDescription: A single partner to maintain, transform and enhance the value of your buildings in Brussels and Walloon Brabant.
home.heroTitle: We take care of your buildings. Every step of the way.
home.heroLead: A single partner to maintain, transform and enhance the value of your properties in Brussels and Walloon Brabant.
home.introTitle: Three areas of expertise. One same standard.
home.introLead: A building lives, evolves and calls for different answers over time.
home.introText: JJD Consult brings maintenance, renovation and project management together under one roof. You get a hands-on team, clear communication and follow-up tailored to every mission.
home.servicesTitle: For every need, the right level of support.
home.service1Baseline: Preserving the value of your buildings.
home.service1Text: A responsive technical partner to maintain, repair and monitor your properties over time.
home.service2Text: Complete renovations coordinated from A to Z, with constant attention to the quality of finishes.
home.service3Baseline: Giving complex projects a clear direction.
home.service3Text: From feasibility study to completion, we structure the choices, the budget and the stakeholders.
home.refTitle: An exceptional property, designed as a whole.
home.refLead: Full renovation and enhancement of a high-end property: interior spaces, technical systems, terraces, surroundings, garden, lawn and pool area.
home.refPoint2: Centralised coordination, a single main contact
home.refPoint3: Finishes followed closely, detail by detail
home.methodTitle: A clear organisation, from first contact to handover.
home.step1Text: Your building, your needs, your priorities and any visible constraints.
home.step2Text: The solution, the quote, the stakeholders and the schedule suited to the mission.
home.step3Text: The works with daily coordination and regular follow-up.
home.step4Text: Quality, finishes and a clear close-out of the intervention.
home.audTitle: A service tailored to every kind of client.
home.audLead: JJD Consult's structure allows us to support an individual owner just as well as the manager of a property portfolio.
home.aud1Text: Renovation, transformation and maintenance of houses, apartments and high-end properties.
home.aud2Text: Multi-technical maintenance, works in common areas and coordinated renovation projects.
home.aud3Text: After-sales service, snagging, remedial works and execution of technical projects.
home.aud4Text: Maintenance, fit-out, potential assessment and transformation of professional or residential buildings.
home.projLead: Considering a purchase, a transformation or several usage scenarios? We assess the property's potential, the works to plan and the budget required before the big decisions.
home.clientLead: A renovation that lasts for months, a portfolio of buildings to manage, after-sales service post-handover: every client gets a private space to follow progress without endless calls and emails — a service few contractors offer.
home.clientPoint2: Quotes to approve online, in one click
home.whyTitle: A hands-on view of the field. Rigorous follow-up.
home.why1Text: A direct, committed and accessible relationship from first contact to handover.
home.why2Text: Technical leadership rooted in the field, driving realistic decisions.
home.why3Text: Priorities explained clearly, structured quotes and understandable follow-up.
home.why4Text: A single partner to preserve continuity between the different trades.
home.ctaTitle: An intervention, a renovation or a project to structure?
home.ctaText: Tell us about the building, its location and your goal. We'll get back to you to determine the best way to proceed.

maintenance.metaDescription: Repairs, interventions and technical follow-up for property managers, developers and businesses in Brussels and Walloon Brabant.
maintenance.heroTitle: Buildings that are looked after. Requests under control.
maintenance.heroLead: Interventions, repairs and technical follow-up with a responsive partner who knows what buildings really need.
maintenance.introTitle: A single point of contact for your buildings.
maintenance.introLead: Centralise more interventions without juggling multiple contractors and follow-up calls.
maintenance.introText: JJD Consult supports property managers and owners with both one-off requests and regular upkeep. Every intervention is scoped, organised and followed through to completion.
maintenance.intervTitle: A structured response, from report to resolution.
maintenance.int1Text: Common areas, leaks, plumbing, electrics, painting, drainage and works coordination.
maintenance.int2Text: Resident appointments, finishing touch-ups, small multi-trade repairs and case closure.
maintenance.int3Text: Repairs, adjustments and upkeep to keep spaces functional and well maintained.
maintenance.int4Text: Scheduled visits, equipment checks, upkeep of the grounds and follow-up reports tailored to the building.
maintenance.methodTitle: Clear for the manager. Practical on site.
maintenance.method2: Site visit and assessment when needed
maintenance.portalTitle: A dedicated portal for your buildings and files.
maintenance.portalLead: Property managers and developers track every intervention online: photos, signed reports, quotes to approve and the week's schedule. For after-sales, every delivered unit becomes a tracked file until all snags are cleared. Co-owners get read-only access to what concerns them.
maintenance.panel1Text: Ongoing interventions and history grouped by building or delivered unit.
maintenance.panel2Text: Dated, illustrated and signed on site by the team.
maintenance.panel3Text: Every open item, handled and closed — visible to both developer and resident.
maintenance.panel4Text: Residents see progress, without financial data.
maintenance.ctaTitle: A building or a portfolio to maintain?
maintenance.ctaText: Tell us about your buildings and your recurring needs. Together we'll work out the most suitable formula.

renovation.metaDescription: Complete, coordinated renovations from A to Z: structural work, building technical systems, interior fit-out, envelope and exteriors.
renovation.heroLead: A complete renovation coordinated from A to Z, with a single point of contact for decisions, trades and finishes.
renovation.introTitle: Far more than a succession of separate trades.
renovation.introLead: We think about the whole site: volumes, technical systems, envelope, finishes and exteriors.
renovation.introText: This overview avoids inconsistencies between work packages, helps anticipate constraints earlier and keeps a clear direction throughout the project.
renovation.postesTitle: Everything that makes up a complete renovation.
renovation.p1Text: Demolition, masonry, openings, structural work and preparation of the new volumes.
renovation.p2Text: Electrics, plumbing, heating, ventilation, drainage and hot water production.
renovation.p3Text: Partitions, plastering, flooring, kitchens, bathrooms, joinery, paint and finishes.
renovation.p4Text: Roofing, waterproofing, insulation, façades, terraces, driveways, garden, lawn and pool area.
renovation.chantierTitle: A renovation that takes months? Follow it online.
renovation.chantierLead: A complete renovation runs over several months. From your private area, you see where every work package stands, this week's photos, the schedule and quotes to approve — without having to chase for updates.
renovation.chantierPoint4: Additional quotes approved in one click
renovation.standingTitle: The same level of rigour, down to every detail.
renovation.standingLead: For an exceptional property, junctions, materials and continuity between interior and exterior matter as much as the major work packages. Our role is to maintain that coherence.
renovation.ctaText: Send us the address, a few photos, any available plans and your goal, so we can set up a first conversation.

projets.metaTitle: Project study and coordination | JJD Consult
projets.metaDescription: From assessing a property's potential to coordinating the works: a realistic, budgeted and coordinated roadmap.
projets.heroLead: We turn a building with potential, or a complex project, into a realistic, budgeted and coordinated roadmap.
projets.introTitle: Giving clear direction to the right decisions.
projets.introLead: A solid project starts before the first hammer blow.
projets.introText: We assess the property's condition, weigh up possible uses, structure the main work packages and identify the specialist studies needed. You move forward with a more realistic view of the project and its budget.
projets.stepsTitle: From idea to site, a structured progression.
projets.step1Text: A general reading of the building, objectives, visible constraints and priorities to look into further.
projets.step2Text: Comparing several layouts, uses or finish levels according to your strategy.
projets.step3Text: Structured costing of the main work packages and preparation of a coherent renovation programme.
projets.step4Text: Consulting partners, planning, execution and follow-up of the different trades.
projets.caseLead: A partially renovated family house and a former post house left untouched. The study made it possible to compare two operating approaches and define the works programme before any major decision.
projets.ctaTitle: Do you own a property to transform?
projets.ctaText: Tell us about the building, its current condition and your goal. We'll help you choose the right level of study.

realisations.metaDescription: A selection of projects: complete renovation, study & valorisation, outdoor developments and transformations.
realisations.heroLead: Renovation, maintenance or project: we adapt the organisation and the teams to what each building actually needs.
realisations.proj1Text: Full transformation of the property: interior, technical systems, terraces, grounds, garden, lawn and pool area.
realisations.proj2Text: Potential assessment, 3D projections, scenario comparison and preparation of the renovation programme.
realisations.proj3Text: Creating an outdoor space coherent with the building, down to the finishes and the junctions with the garden.
realisations.proj4Text: Modernising the exterior appearance and durably improving the building's protection.
realisations.proj5Text: Complete overhaul of a passage space for clearer circulation and refined finishes.
realisations.proj6Text: Reorganising access routes and restoring the grounds for a cleaner, more practical and durable whole.
realisations.proj7Text: Redistribution, renovation and interior finishes coordinated within an overall vision.
realisations.proj8Text: Structural and roofing works carried out with particular attention to stability and waterproofing.
realisations.confidentialityNote: Some references are presented anonymously to respect the confidentiality of our clients and partners.
realisations.ctaTitle: Your project could be the next one.
realisations.ctaText: Tell us about your needs and the level of support you're looking for. We'll suggest a first approach tailored to you.

aPropos.metaDescription: JJD Consult, a family construction business: clear organisation, direct relationships and over 20 years of experience.
aPropos.heroLead: JJD Consult supports individuals and professionals with clear organisation, a direct relationship and over 20 years of experience in construction.
aPropos.histoireTitle: Building a relationship as solid as the works themselves.
aPropos.histoireLead: JJD Consult was born from a simple conviction: clients need a partner who understands the realities on site and stays with them until the very end.
aPropos.histoirePara1: Our technical leadership draws on over 20 years of experience in construction, technical installations, renovation and project follow-up. This experience lets us identify constraints early and propose practical solutions.
aPropos.histoirePara2: Our family structure keeps communication direct. You always know who to contact, what has been decided and how the project is progressing.
aPropos.valeur1Text: Answering, organising and keeping you informed so no request gets lost.
aPropos.valeur2Text: Preparing interventions, controlling execution and taking care over finishes.
aPropos.valeur3Text: Explaining priorities, constraints and the consequences of decisions.
aPropos.valeur4Text: Following every project with the same attention, whatever its scale.
aPropos.structureLead: These three areas of expertise let us support a building at every stage of its life: everyday upkeep, complete transformation, or a project requiring wider study and coordination.
aPropos.ctaText: Tell us about your building and your expectations. We'll tell you clearly how JJD Consult can support you.
